name: Bitcoin USD
oneLiner: BtcUSD is BTCfi's overcollateralized USD stablecoin minted from BTC variants (WBTC, BTCB, cbBTC, native BTC) via Liquity-style CDP vaults.
collateral: Overcollateralized Bitcoin (WBTC, BTCB, cbBTC, native BTC) via CDP vaults

oracleRisk.summary: BTCFi documents 50% maximum LTV and liquidation risk, while Bifrost publishes native WBTC and BTCB price feeds; BTCFi's own docs do not prove which feed is wired into BtcUSD or document liquidation recovery and oracle-failure handling.

branchApplicability.rationale: BtcUSD is minted against Bitcoin collateral and therefore requires an oracle/liquidation branch review. The public BTCFi documentation describes one Bifrost-side mint workflow but does not expose separate market contracts or prove distinct collateral engines, so the documented collateral set is represented as one grouped branch and retained as opaque.

branches.label: BTCFi Bifrost Bitcoin collateral
branches.summary: BTCFi exposes a single Bifrost-side BtcUSD borrowing workflow, but its docs do not identify the price-feed contract consumed by the collateral and liquidation logic.

feeds.path: Undocumented collateral price input -> BtcUSD LTV and liquidation checks; Bifrost's published WBTC/BTCB feeds are candidates, not proven BTCFi wiring

branches.fallbackBehavior: BTCFi's public documentation does not describe staleness checks, a secondary oracle, or the behavior taken when its collateral-price source is unavailable.

collateralParameters.note: The BTCFi mint guide says users may mint up to 50% of collateral value and warns of liquidation at the liquidation threshold, but it does not publish a separate liquidation-ratio value.

branches.liquidationMechanism: The BTCFi mint and repay guides warn that positions reaching the liquidation threshold can be liquidated, but do not document who executes liquidation, the sale or offset sequence, or any execution delay.
branches.backstop: No Stability Pool, insurance reserve, debt auction, or other liquidation backstop is identified in the reviewed BTCFi documentation.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: The reviewed BTCFi documentation does not specify an oracle-failure pause, emergency shutdown, or how collateral shortfall and residual bad debt would be allocated.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: BtcUSD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: BtcUSD on Base is an ERC20_Bridged (Vyper) contract whose canonical issuance lives on the Bifrost network. The Base bridge token has 2 owners: a contract (0x26fce52a..., not a Safe) and an EOA (0xf98e8601...). The native BtcUSD CDP on Bifrost cannot be verified: no publicly accessible keyless EVM-compatible RPC exists for the Bifrost chain.

controls.label: BTCfi CDP vault on Bifrost (collateral mint — unverifiable)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by the per-vault overcollateralization ratio against BTC-variant collateral, with liquidation below the minimum ratio.
controls.evidence: Native BtcUSD is minted on the Bifrost chain via Liquity-v1-style CDP vaults; chain state is not accessible via keyless EVM RPC from this environment.

controls.label: BtcUSD Base bridge owner contract
controls.evidence: At Base block 48621895, get_owners() on the ERC20_Bridged token returned this contract as one of two current owners. The verified bridge implementation permits token owners to mint bridged BtcUSD directly; the owner contract is not verified as a Safe or bounded multisig.

controls.label: BtcUSD Base bridge owner EOA
controls.evidence: At Base block 48621895, get_owners() on the ERC20_Bridged token returned this EOA as one of two current owners. The verified bridge implementation permits token owners to mint bridged BtcUSD directly.

controls.label: BtcUSD Base proxy admin (unverified contract)
controls.evidence: At Base block 48621895, the EIP-1967 admin slot of the BtcUSD bridge proxy returned this deployed contract and the implementation slot returned 0x6e9070b8. The admin contract is not source-verified, so its owner, delay, and signer policy remain unknown.

review.evidence: At Base block 48621895: BtcUSD (0xe4b20925...) is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy with EIP-1967 admin 0x55506bcc5fa9b2e702848aa110b5a6987a735060 and implementation 0x6e9070b8a8dbbc6cad6b6d029a5c6f6a653b74a9. get_owners() returned 0x26fce52a (contract) and 0xf98e8601 (EOA), both direct bridge-token mint owners. The proxy-admin contract is unverified, and the canonical Bifrost CDP issuance path remains unverifiable without accessible chain state.
unresolvedQuestions: Bifrost chain has no accessible keyless EVM RPC; cannot verify the native BtcUSD CDP vault admin or whether ownership is renounced on Bifrost. Additionally, the Base bridge token proxy admin (0x55506bcc...) is unverified and its ownership chain is not confirmed (slot-0 interpretation unclear).

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: BtcUSD/BTCFi relies on Bifrost cross-chain technology for collateral movement across networks. Bifrost bridge documentation describes a cross-chain bridge service rather than a native issuer-only route, so Pharos scores this as external validated-network exposure.
